command_templates.name: load_hive
command_templates.when: When loading a single hive file.

usage_description: A GUI tool for viewing and analyzing offline Registry hives, supporting multiple hives and advanced searching.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Deleted keys or values in SYSTEM hive
suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates potential tampering or deletion of critical system settings.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Unusual entries in user hives (e.g., NTUSER.DAT, USRCLASS.DAT)
suspicious_indicators.description: May indicate unauthorized software installation or configuration changes.

known_false_positives: Registry keys and values that are part of legitimate system updates or patches may appear unusual without context.
Deleted records can be a normal part of system maintenance, but should still be investigated for potential tampering.
